title: TikTok Profile & Video Stats
description: Retrieves TikTok creator videos. Free-only mode never uses the paid TikHub API but may be blocked by TikTok; optional authenticated TikHub retrieval requires explicit opt-in.

usernames.title: TikTok usernames
usernames.description: 1–200 TikTok usernames; large batches can require more runtime.

videosPerProfile.title: Videos per profile
videosPerProfile.description: Number of recent public videos to analyze per creator (1–30). Discovery is best-effort and may return fewer when TikTok blocks access; coverage reports incompleteness.

excludePinned.title: Exclude pinned videos
excludePinned.description: Exclude videos only when TikTok explicitly identifies them as pinned. Unknown pin status is retained and reported in coverage warnings.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: full returns profile, video, and summary rows. profileOnly stops after profile data.

minFollowers.title: Minimum followers
minFollowers.description: Optional minimum follower count. Profiles below this are skipped before video loading.

maxFollowers.title: Maximum followers
maxFollowers.description: Optional maximum follower count. Profiles above this are skipped before video loading.

maxItems.title: Maximum dataset rows
maxItems.description: Hard ceiling on dataset rows produced by this Actor.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum creator profiles processed simultaneously. Capped at 2.

outputRows.title: Dataset output rows
outputRows.description: Select all rows or summary rows only.

retrievalMode.title: Video retrieval mode
retrievalMode.description: Free only is the default and never calls TikHub, even if a token is configured. TikHub fallback uses a potentially paid external API and requires TIKHUB_API_TOKEN.

useResidentialProxy.title: Use residential proxy for browser fallback (may incur Apify charges)
useResidentialProxy.description: Off by default. Enable only if you accept Apify residential proxy charges. Free-only mode never requires a residential proxy.
